tpms.when: 2023 Range Rover (sensors in each road wheel; no reset button)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker. The pressures the car advises are also shown in its Tire Pressures menu.
There is no reset button. The system reads each wheel's sensor by itself, so correct pressures are what clear the light.
With the vehicle stopped and the ignition on, check the TPMS load setting menu: Light suits fewer occupants and Normal suits more (the cut-off depends on whether the car has five or more seats).
If a wheel or tire was removed or swapped, let the car sit for 15 minutes, then drive for at least 15 minutes so the system can relearn.
Drive above about 16 mph. A warning should update or clear within about 5 to 10 minutes.
If the light stays on after that, have the system checked by a qualified shop.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute or more and then stays on, that is a system fault or a lost sensor signal, which setting pressures will not clear. The spare is not monitored.
